runs.text: is the value the text gives for the cathode with less Mn, and
is the value for the cathode with more Mn

. The paper words these as "charge capacities", but the sentence is about the loss of discharge capacity as Mn content rises, which it attributes to the electrochemical inactivity of the Mn ions. The discharge curves in

rendered: 212 mAh g^− 1 (10% Mn)[1] is the value the text gives for the cathode with less Mn, and 164 mAh g^− 1[2] is the value for the cathode with more Mn (50% Mn)[3]. The paper words these as "charge capacities", but the sentence is about the loss of discharge capacity as Mn content rises, which it attributes to the electrochemical inactivity of the Mn ions. The discharge curves in Fig. 4[4] (panel a) show the same trend.
